activeScopes.description: The scopes that are active. Only commands in an active scope fire.

conflictBehavior.description: What to do when two commands register the same hotkey. warn keeps both and logs, replace drops the earlier one, allow keeps both silently, error refuses the second.

defaultOptions.description: Options applied to every command registered under this provider. Per-command options override it.

sequenceTimeoutMs.description: How long a sequence like G > H waits for the next key before resetting.

hotkey.description: The key combination, such as mod+K, shift+alt+D or the sequence G > H. mod resolves to Command on macOS and Control elsewhere.

options.description: Everything on UseHotkeysCommand except id, hotkey and action. The id is generated for you.

commands.description: The commands to register. Each is keyed by id, so changing one re-registers only that command.

id.description: Unique identifier. Used to reconcile registrations across renders and to unregister on unmount.

hotkey.description: The key combination or sequence that triggers the command.

label.description: Human-readable name. Read back by useHotkeyRegistrations, so a command palette can render it.

description.description: Longer explanation of what the command does.

category.description: Group name, for sectioning a command palette.

keywords.description: Alternative search terms. Lets a palette match "dark" against a command labelled "Toggle theme".

scopes.description: The scopes this command belongs to. It only fires while one of them is active.

enabled.description: Whether the command can fire. A function is re-evaluated on every key press, so it reads current state without re-registering.

options.description: Per-command behavior. Overrides the provider defaultOptions.

preventDefault.description: Call preventDefault() on the event before running the action.

stopPropagation.description: Call stopPropagation() on the event before running the action.

enableOnFormTags.description: Whether a single-key shortcut fires while an input, textarea or select has focus. Shortcuts with a modifier always fire. Pass an array to opt in to specific tags.

enableOnContentEditable.description: Whether the shortcut fires inside a contenteditable element.

requireReset.description: Fire once per press. The key must be released before it fires again, which suppresses key repeat.

eventType.description: Whether to fire on press or on release. Pair a keyup command with a keydown one on the same key for push-to-talk.

target.description: Scope the command to a DOM subtree. It only fires when the event originates inside this element, which must contain focus. Resolved on every event, and skipped while it resolves to null.

returns.description: Every command currently registered on the store, with its label, category, keywords and resolved hotkey. Re-reads when commands are added or removed, which is what lets a command palette be a view over the registry instead of a second list to keep in sync.

The store from the nearest HotkeysProvider, or a shared default store if there is none. Use setScope, addScope, removeScope and toggleScope to change which commands are live, and isPressed to test a combination directly.
The keys currently held down. Use it when a held key changes what an interaction means, such as Shift to extend a selection.

hotkey.description: The key or combination to watch.

returns.description: Whether that key or combination is currently held.
The current platform, one of 'mac', 'windows' or 'linux'. Resolves after mount, so server and client render the same markup.

A formatter bound to the current platform, so mod+K renders as ⌘ K on macOS and Ctrl K elsewhere. Prefer this over importing formatHotkey directly inside a component, which reads the platform during render and mismatches on hydration.

props.description: Accepts onRecord, onCancel, onClear, formatOptions and sequenceTimeoutMs.

state.description: The recorder state. recording is whether it is listening, value is the hotkey recorded so far.

stop.description: Stop listening and keep the recorded hotkey.

cancel.description: Stop listening and discard the recorded hotkey. Also triggered by Escape.

clear.description: Clear the recorded hotkey. Also triggered by Backspace or Delete.
